items.title: Use Bring Your Own ASN (BYOASN) to enforce data sovereignty on AWS Direct Connect public VIFs
items.summary: SaaS providers can use Bring Your Own ASN (BYOASN) on AWS Direct Connect public VIFs to assign a distinct ASN per Region, giving end customers a standard BGP AS_PATH signal to enforce data sovereignty without relying on fragile per-Region prefix lists.
items.creator: Gonzalo Escarrá
